🌏 Are you ready to lead transformative energy initiatives and shape the just energy transition in Latin America and the Caribbean?
 
🔎 Now hiring: Regional Energy Specialist (IPSA-11)
📍 Location: UNDP Regional Hub – Panama City, Panama
🔗 Apply here: https://bit.ly/LAC-energy
👉 Apply by: April 8, 2025
 
UNDP is seeking a Regional Energy Specialist to support energy programming in Latin America and the Caribbean through the Sustainable Energy Hub. The role focuses on technical assistance, policy advisory, and regional coordination in the areas of energy access, energy finance, and low-carbon systems.
 
Key responsibilities include:
•  Advising country offices on energy policy design and implementation and leading technical inputs for renewable energy and energy access programmes
•  Engaging with regional stakeholders including public and private sector and finance institutions
•  Foster partnerships that empower communities and enhance regional energy resilience
•  Contributing to knowledge products and regional strategic documents on energy access and transition pathways
 
Please share with qualified colleagues or apply directly.
